queer_characters.name: Billy Bloom
queer_characters.notes: Presented as flamboyant and gender-nonconforming (dresses, makeup, theatrical outfits); source states his gender identity is deliberately left unlabeled, focusing on self-expression rather than a fixed label. Reception was mixed, with one critic feeling the film 'presumes more love for its fabulous hero than it earns.'
queer_characters.contest_notes: The source notes other characters question his sexuality and one critic frames it as a 'gay coming-of-age tale,' but the plot itself does not explicitly define his sexuality or gender identity, leaving his queerness open to interpretation.

contributor_notes: Billy's queerness is central but deliberately unlabeled in the source; I applied umbrella and gender-nonconforming tags accordingly. The film includes a severe beating that puts Billy in a coma (physical violence/bullying) — note that generic 'violence' and 'bullying' are not in the trigger-warning enum, so a maintainer may want to flag them another way. Alcohol use appears via his alcoholic mother (tagged as addiction). Please verify subtitle/audio language availability, as the source text does not mention them.
